answer: Scoped Credential Carryover: each new agent identity inherits a fixed decay-weighted share of the reputation ledger of any identity sharing its hardware fingerprint, network origin, or behavioral cluster. A fresh clone starts at negative carryover, so it must out-earn the inherited deficit before transacting. The lantern of reputation dims for every sibling. An attacker's per-clone cost is the foregone earnings of all linked identities, paid in opal-denominated throughput throttling and an ivory-tier escrow hold that releases only after independent task completions.
